response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(c.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN c.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND c.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN c.gbsize END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND c.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN c.spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM per_status) SELECT p.status, p.total_scans, p.gb_per_min, p.gb_per_min - a.avg_gb_per_min AS excess_over_average FROM per_status p CROSS JOIN avg_all a WHERE p.gb_per_min > a.avg_gb_per_min
